title: Search
body: Filter every flat in the estate by block, floor, budget and move-in date. Shortlist what you like, or tell us what you need and we'll shortlist for you.

title: Visit
body: Pick a slot and we'll walk you through every flat on your list in one go, keys in hand. Video walkthroughs for out-of-town families.

title: Documents
body: We draft the agreement, check the owner's papers and handle registration. You'll see the deposit, maintenance and our fee in writing first.

title: Move in
body: Keys, inventory checklist with photos, meter readings and the association contact. We stay on call for the first month.
